name: ptc-run
description: Programmatic tool calling: run_code runs a JS program that calls read/glob/grep/edit/bash in a sandbox and returns only the final value; large results spill to refs.

nudgeAfter.title: Remind after (consecutive single-step requests)
nudgeAfter.description: Main session requests that each sent exactly one Bash/Read/Grep/Glob call, with no run_code and no dispatch, before one reminder line is injected. 0 turns the reminder off. PTC_RUN_NUDGE overrides it.

bashMaxChars.title: Bash output cap (characters)
bashMaxChars.description: A Bash result over this keeps the first 60% and the last 30%; the middle becomes one marker line naming the file that holds the whole text under ~/.claude/ptc-run/overflow/. 0 turns it off. PTC_RUN_BASH_MAX overrides it.
